name: Web Repository Architecture
description: Architecture for the CALM web repository, covering the static web server that hosts repository assets behind authenticated HTTPS access and the retained validation workflow documentation that still awaits a follow-up auth-aware update.

nodes.name: Architect
nodes.description: A human architect or operator who requests the web site and documentation assets from the local static server over authenticated HTTPS and reviews the retained validation workflow.

nodes.name: Nginx Static Web Server
nodes.description: The nginx container defined in compose.yaml that serves static repository content and CALM architecture assets only over HTTPS on port 8443, and exposes the reverse proxy used for the local Keycloak/OIDC flow.

nodes.name: OAuth2 Proxy
nodes.description: The oauth2-proxy container that enforces OIDC sign-in for the static site and forwards authenticated requests to the nginx front end.

nodes.name: Keycloak Identity Provider
nodes.description: The Keycloak container that runs the calm-local realm, exposes OIDC endpoints, and serves the local authentication flow used by oauth2-proxy.

nodes.name: Keycloak Realm Configuration
nodes.description: The imported realm definition for calm-local that provisions the OAuth client and the local test user used by the authentication stack.

nodes.name: CALM Artifacts (Static)
nodes.description: The static content bundle exposed by the nginx server, including architecture JSON, patterns, standards, and documentation assets.

nodes.name: Architecture Validation Script
nodes.description: The retained shell script in scripts/validate-architecture.sh that still contains legacy remote validation commands and awaits a follow-up auth-aware update.

nodes.name: CALM CLI
nodes.description: The CALM CLI used by the retained validation script and related local validation workflows.

nodes.name: Docker Container
nodes.description: A container grouping that hosts the nginx web server, oauth2-proxy, Keycloak, and the repository static content assets for the local stack.

relationships.description: Architects request the repository's static web site and assets from the nginx server over authenticated HTTPS.
Run validation tests as an architect
The nginx server serves static repository assets from the repository content bundle.
Nginx routes authentication callbacks and auth checks to oauth2-proxy so the site can be protected by Keycloak-backed OIDC.
oauth2-proxy validates users and tokens against the Keycloak realm during sign-in and session exchange.
Nginx exposes Keycloak's admin and OIDC endpoints under /keycloak/ for local sign-in and realm management.
Keycloak loads the imported calm-local realm definition at startup so the OAuth client and test user are available.
The validation script invokes the CALM CLI to run validation commands against the exposed assets.
Follow-up work is required for the CALM CLI to validate architecture documents by loading them from the local nginx server over authenticated HTTPS.
The Docker container groups the nginx web server, oauth2-proxy, Keycloak, and the repository static content assets.
